current_answer: The Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% on October 28; the next scheduled decision is December 9. At about 13:35 UTC October 30, Kalshi’s December Hike 25bps Chance heading and Polymarket’s separate 25 bps increase named row each showed 72%, down five percentage points from their October 29 19:06 UTC page checks. Both still favor a quarter-point hike. Page access times are not quote times, and the cause of the decline is unknown.

summary: Next scheduled decision: December 9, 2026. The October 28 result was a hold at 3.75%–4.00%.
At about 13:35 UTC October 30, the Kalshi December Hike 25bps Chance heading and Polymarket’s separate named 25 bps increase row each showed 72%.
Both hike displays were 77% at the October 29 19:06 UTC page check; the timing and cause of the decline are unknown.
uncertainty: Market-page access times are not venue quote times; displays are unsynchronized, rounded and may be cached.
